items.title: Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement or Medical Treatment for Paradoxical Low-Flow, Low-Gradient Aortic Valve Stenosis: REBOOT-PARADOX
items.title_zh: REBOOT-PARADOX随机试验:TAVR对比单纯药物治疗矛盾型低流速、低压差重度主动脉瓣狭窄,死亡率未达统计学差异
items.summary_zh: REBOOT-PARADOX是首项专门比较TAVR联合优化药物治疗(OMT)与单纯OMT在症状性矛盾型低流速、低压差重度主动脉瓣狭窄(主动脉瓣口面积≤1.0cm²、平均跨瓣压差<40mmHg、每搏输出量指数<35mL/m²、射血分数≥50%)患者中疗效的多中心开放标签随机对照试验,在2026年ESC年会Hot Line环节公布并发表于《Circulation》。因入组缓慢,原计划入组783例患者最终仅纳入120例(TAVR组80例、OMT组40例,中位年龄82岁,女性占53.3%),OMT组中19例因症状进展而交叉接受TAVR。主要终点全因死亡率TAVR组为29.0%,OMT组为37.1%(HR 0.83,95%CI 0.41-1.66,P=0.60);5年全因死亡率两组分别为44.9%和56.6%(HR 0.76,95%CI 0.43-1.35,P=0.35),均未达统计学显著性。研究者认为该试验因样本量不足未能明确TAVR对此类患者死亡率的获益,支持密切随访、症状恶化后再行TAVR的个体化策略,呼吁开展更大样本的随机试验。
items.summary_en: REBOOT-PARADOX is the first multicenter, open-label randomized trial dedicated to comparing TAVR plus optimal medical therapy (OMT) versus OMT alone in symptomatic paradoxical low-flow, low-gradient severe aortic stenosis (aortic valve area ≤ 1.0 cm², mean gradient < 40 mm Hg, stroke volume index < 35 mL/m², ejection fraction ≥ 50%), presented as an ESC Congress 2026 Hot Line and published in Circulation. Slow recruitment forced early termination, with only 120 of a planned 783 patients randomized (80 TAVR, 40 OMT; median age 82, 53.3% women), and 19 OMT patients crossing over to TAVR for symptom progression. All-cause death, the primary endpoint, occurred in 29.0% with TAVR versus 37.1% with OMT (HR 0.83; 95% CI, 0.41-1.66; P=0.60), and 5-year mortality was 44.9% versus 56.6% (HR 0.76; 95% CI, 0.43-1.35; P=0.35) — neither reaching statistical significance. The underpowered trial leaves TAVR's mortality benefit in this subgroup unresolved, supporting an individualized strategy of close surveillance with timely TAVR upon clinical deterioration, and underscores the need for an adequately powered trial.
